method: All101 complete action/replay streams inspected for DOM snapshots, input events, post-CTA mouse movement, scrolling, clicks, validation and submit errors; values were not read for analysis.
findings: All25 sessions that input data convert; all75 CTA-abandon sessions have no input.
The observable loss occurs before beginning form entry, not during submission.
No observed validation or submission error explains non-converting sessions.

next_hypothesis.claim: Clarifying the application step and short purpose requirement may reduce perceived commitment/effort before form entry.
next_hypothesis.confidence: low; no input events reveal why visitors decide not to begin
next_hypothesis.prediction: Input-start/CTA and confirmed conversion increase; input-start-to-success remains high.
next_hypothesis.falsifier: No rise in genuine input starts or confirmed conversions despite clear exposure.

limitations: 101 page loads versus100 simulator visits; an extra page load is not attributed to a human or agent.
No inference about demographics or real mobile users.
Uniform scripted behavior cannot establish emotions or intent.
